t: Roles let you message a job, like the IT help desk or HR, instead of guessing who to ask.
In this video, you will learn how to message a role, follow your requests, and set roles up.
Click Work in the left menu, then Roles.
Each card is a role: IT help desk, HR desk, Accounts, Facilities. It shows who answers, and who is online.
Press Message on a role, write what you need, and press Send. The first person in the list who is in and free gets it.
If nobody replies in time, it moves on to the next person, or their manager.
Below are your requests and those for your roles: waiting, answered, escalated, or closed. Press Chat to open one, or Close when it is done.
Admins press New role: a name, an icon, what it is for, when to move on, and who answers, in order.
Next in the Work menu: Visitors.
